result:
I walked the dictation flow on the phone sheet (400 px) and the desktop drawer (1200 px), through real Whisper. **New session** was broken and is now fixed and merged: on both surfaces, the first sentence after the press used to drop you back into the old conversation.

The walk played a spoken recording as the microphone and took a screenshot after every tap. It ran twice per surface, before and after the fix. Three more fixes landed in the same merge:
- **First sentence:** the first sentence after New session sometimes vanished from the phone sheet. It now always shows.
- **Phone sheet header:** the title was the class name "DrawerRailSheetChat"; it now says "AI". New session moved into the header, so it is one tap, as on the desktop.
- **Refused microphone:** with the microphone refused, the error message ran off the right edge at 400 px. It now wraps.

What passes now:
- Bubbles appear in the same order as the session file, on both surfaces.
- The sheet drags up to full height, and the AI, Dictation and Settings tabs appear.
- The listening indicator shows while the mic is open.
- The phone and the desktop show the same words for the same session.
- The Refine page shows the same sentences.

⚠️ **Three problems are left, all in Servex, which this task was not allowed to change:**
